SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, MIN(calendar_date) d0, MAX(calendar_date) d1, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN is_trading_day THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) trading
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period = 2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND NOT (s.store_id = 900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl_sales
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = c.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND c.store_id <> 999
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week, w.net_sales, c.ctl_sales, w.net_sales - c.ctl_sales AS gap
FROM weekly w JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT 'sales' t, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) d_rl, MIN(etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(etl_loaded_at) mx,
  SUM(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2025-06-29' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-05' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) inrange
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2025-06-29' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-05'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), NULL, NULL, 0
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-26' AND DATE '2025-06-22' OR return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_orders', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id), SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), NULL, NULL, 0
FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-19' AND DATE '2025-06-29' OR CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-05'

SELECT 'cal' k, fiscal_year a, CAST(fiscal_period AS VARCHAR) b, CAST(fully_loaded AS VARCHAR) c, CAST(period_start_date AS VARCHAR) d, CAST(period_end_date AS VARCHAR) e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'closure', CAST(store_id AS VARCHAR), closure_type, CAST(weeks_closed AS VARCHAR), CAST(closure_start_date AS VARCHAR), CAST(closure_end_date AS VARCHAR) FROM ref_store_closure
WHERE closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26' AND closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-28' AND (closure_start_date <= DATE '2025-06-22' AND closure_end_date >= DATE '2025-05-26' OR closure_start_date <= DATE '2026-06-28' AND closure_end_date >= DATE '2026-06-01')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'web_noDispatch', status, CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS VARCHAR), NULL, NULL FROM fact_web_order WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-25' AND DATE '2026-07-05' GROUP BY status

SELECT ty.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year, ty.fiscal_week AS fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ly.fiscal_year AS last_year_fiscal_year,
       ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
